$comment: Aggregate skill source manifest. Every entry is a PUBLIC GitHub repo containing SKILL.md files. The build mirrors ONLY the skill directories, drops large/binary assets, and enforces the dsh-skills-manager limits (500 skills / 32MiB whole-repo zip). Files remain the property of their upstream authors — see each license field.
$ordering: Sources are processed in array order. The panel REJECTS duplicate skill names, so a later source can only replace an earlier one by listing that skill name in its `overrides` array. Put preferred/localized versions LAST with explicit overrides.

sources.name: Anthropics_skills_zh-CN
sources.$why: Chinese localization of anthropics/skills. Placed after and given explicit overrides so the zh-CN text wins for Chinese users instead of being shadowed by the English originals.

sources.name: Skill-hub
sources.$why: Community hub with Chinese-language skills not covered elsewhere. Lowest priority: never overrides the curated official/zh sets.
